newsitem.title: UK: UK's IMS to be floated at 135p/share - Hambros.
newsitem.headline: UK's IMS to be floated at 135p/share - Hambros.

text.p: Hambros Bank Ltd said on Thursday that IMS Group Plc, a British provider of inbound automated telephony services, would be floated on the London Stock Exchange at 135p per share in February.

Hambros, acting for IMS, said the institutional placing of 22,222,131 ordinary shares would raise around 13.9 million stg for IMS net of expenses and give the company a market capitalisation of 44.6 million stg.

Hambros said 7.0 million stg of the proceeds would be used to redeem preference shares and 3.0 million to repay most of IMS's borrowing. The balance would be used to fund acquisitions and product development.
Dealing in the shares was expected to start on February 6, Hambros said.
